snippet.title: 🐀 Royal Vermin - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The game where even the least skilled player can win is out now!
That feeling when you’re holding a fully loaded trash bag and everyone starts running… you have to experience it.
Spring break = Royal Vermin night! And if you really want to leave the junkyard behind, the “Beyond the Waste” DLC is waiting for you.
www.royalvermin.com
